tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'jig rten dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs sems dpa' bzhi brtsegs grub dbang thang stong rgyal po'i lugs kyi ma ṇi bum sgrub byin rlabs kun 'byung bzhugs so// na mo gu ru lo ki shwa ra s+d+ya la shu n+ya tā rā dzā ya/ shākya'i rgyal sras tog gyur gang gi sku/ /sku mchog mthong bas mi ngom blta na mdzes/ /mdzes skus dmyal khams bco brgyad sdug bsngal sel/ /mthong ba don ldan sku der bsngags par 'os/ /rgyal ba'i gsung gi bcud bsdus oṃ dang ni/ /ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ gi gsung dbyangs kyis/ /yi dwags phongs sgrol rgyal sras gsung gi bcud/ /dad pas 'dud do ngag la dngos grub stsol/ /mnyam nyid rdo rje lta bu'i thugs kyis ni/ /'gro drug spyi dang khyad par gangs can la/ /thugs rjes gzigs pa'i mgon gcig spyan ras gzigs/ /skyabs gzhan med do da lta thugs rjes gzung / /rgyal sras yon tan spyi dang byams snying rje/ /byang chub thugs 'byongs lhag pa'i phul gyur pa/ /bsam yas brjod par dka' ba'i yon tan che/ /snying nas dad pas phyag 'tshal de 'drar shog /lhun grub rgyun mi chad pa'i phrin las kyis/ /'khor ba ji srid de srid ngang gis 'jug /mkha' mnyam 'gro 'di zhi ba la 'god pa'i/ /ma 'dris mdza' bshes che de rab mchod de/ /gong gi byin rlabs yig drug bum dbang 'di/ /mtshan snyan grub dbang thang stong dbang po'i lugs/ /spyan gzigs bzhi brtsegs cho ga bshad kyis nyon/ /mkhas rmongs kun gyis 'di la gus par gyis/ /'dir thugs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs dbang dang bcas pa la/ dpal mo lugs/ rgyal po lugs kyi dgongs pa gcig tu bsdus shing / grub pa'i dbang phyug rang gi dag snang las byung ba'i sems dpa' bzhi brtsegs su grags pa dpal chu bo ri'i rtser chog khrigs su mdzad pa gzhir bzhag ste khrigs su bya ba la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes so/ /dang po sngon 'gro ni dus bzang po la yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su bla re/

yol ba/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten gyi drung du rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor pad+ma 'dab ma bcu gnyis pa'i nang du pad+ma 'dab ma bcu pa de'i steng du 'dab ma bzhi/ lte bar tshon spung ngam yang na me tog gi tshom bu bkod/ de'i mthar chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer mchod kyang bshams/ logs gang ba re dkar gtor gsum yang bshams/ bum rdzas ci 'byor dang sbyar ba'i chus bkang gsung ba gsar rnying gang rigs kyi bum rdzas nyer lnga nges par dgos/ 'ga' zhig tu dung chos rdor gzungs sogs med par bdag mdun gyi phyag g.yas gsum pa mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i mthil nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang ba mdzad kyang / 'dir nges par rdor gzungs mdzad pa/ gos dri ma med pa'i mgul chings/ 'o ma can gyi shing gi kha rgyan gsung kyang / spyi ltar ku sha rma bya'i sgros brgyan/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bkod/ de nas tho rengs lag ris mthong ba dang khrus byas/ gtsang sbra dang bcas pas cho ga nyams len la 'jug par bya ba ni sngon 'gro'i chos so/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la rang gi mdun du sems can thams cad snying khong rus pa'i gting nas skyabs su 'gro bar bsams la skyabs 'gro bya ba'i pha mas gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas la skyabs༞ chos la༞ dge 'dun la༞ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la༞ mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes lan gsum dang / sangs rgyas chos dang sogs/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yis/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /shes rab snying rje dang bcas pas/ /brtson pas sems can don du bdag /sangs rgyas drung du gnas bcas nas/

/rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed bgyi/ /dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sogs/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de yi phyir du bdag gi 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i sgrub pa nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /bdag bskyed ni/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi lte bar thugs rje chen po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ snying gar zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ mgrin par bcu gcig zhal/ spyi bor phyag stong spyan stong rnams sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hrīḥl sogs yi ge bkod/ gnas bzhi byin gyis brlabs/ ye shes pa dgug dbang bskur nas rigs bdag gis rgyas 'debs pa'i bar rnams mdun bskyed dang mthun par byas la/ rang gi rnam smin gyi lus sbyangs sems thugs rje chen po bzhi'i ngo bor gyur par bsam/ de nas rang gi thugs ka'i sngags rnams klog pa'i tshul du bzlas pas yig 'bru rnams las 'od 'phros/ snod kyi 'jig rten la phog po tā lar gyur/ bcud kyi sems can la phog sdig sgrib sbyangs nas thugs rje chen por gyur par bsam mo/ /mchod bstod ni/ oṃ ar+ya a wa lo ki shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke ghan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+ta pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs sh+lau ka gcig jo bo thugs rje chen pos bdag dang sems thams cad kyi rgyud la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bcos ma ma yin pa rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ spyan 'dren ni/ phyogs dus kun na skyabs gsum bka' sdod cing / /nyon mongs 'gro la mkhyen brtses rab dgongs nas/ /dpag med zhing nas thogs med rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /'dir gshegs mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i dbus bzhugs gsol/

/bcom ldan thugs rjes byon pa legs/ /bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ /pad+ma ka ma la ye satwaṃ/ khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa/ /shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher ba bstar/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan/ /mu tig 'od chags bla re bres pa der/ /de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la/ /rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus/ /yid 'ong legs par bkang bas glu dang ni/ /rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī āḥhūm̐/ don dam spros pa'i mtha' dang bral na yang / /kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bu'i mchod yon 'di/ /rgyal ba sras bcas sgyu ma lta bu la/ /phul bas 'gro kun sgyu ma'i don rtogs shog /oṃ ar+ya a wa lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ 'gre'o/ /hrīḥlas byung ba'i mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /gangs ri'i mdog can༞ /g.yon pa ut+pal༞ /rab mdzes zhi ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa dang / skyon gyis ma gos༞ /spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi sku/ /'gro drug sems can༞ /nam mkha' lta bur༞ /gzi brjid 'od dpag med la༞ /phyag stong 'khor los༞༞༞ /btsun pa spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa sh+lau ka bzhi brjod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par bstim/ slar yang lte ba'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rgyal ba rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ sogs kyis mchod/ chos sku nam mkhas bstod/ de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams nas/ /rol mor bcas pa'i bar byed/ bdag bskyed kyi lha la mngon par dbang bskur ba mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rigs lnga'i thugs ka nas yum sangs rgyas spyan ma/

ma ma kī/ gos dkar mo/ sgron ma bzhis bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs te/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /zhes sh+lau ka gcig byed/ oṃ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar rdo rje sems dpa'/ rna ba g.yas par rin chen 'byung ldan/ ltag par rnam par snang mdzad/ rna ba g.yon par don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ rang gi rnam smin gyi lus sbyangs/ sems thugs rje chen po bzhi'i ngo bor gyur/ bdag bskyed kyi lha'i yig 'bru rnams klog pa'i tshul du bzlas pas/ yig 'bru rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ snod kyi 'jig rten la phog po tā lar gyur/ bcud kyi sems can la phog sdig sgrib sbyangs nas thugs rje chen po bzhi'i ngo bor gyur par bsam/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng du/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ bcu gcig zhal gyi thugs kar pad zla'i steng du/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥ.ar+ya dz+nyā na sa ga ra bai ro tsa na bhu ha ra dzā ya/ zhes pa gzungs ring gcig gi 'go byas la gzungs thung nyi shu rtsa gcig 'dren no/ /phyag stong spyan stong gi thugs kar pad zla'i steng du gzungs ring nyer gcig byed/ mchod pa ni/ snang la rang bzhin med pa'i rgyal ba la/ /snang la rang bzhin med pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /snang stong dbyer med sems kyis sprul nas 'bul/ /dmigs med spros bral ngang du bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ ar+ya a wa lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ kun la 'gre'o/ /hrīḥlas byung ba'i mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /sogs dang / phyag stong 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po stong / /sogs/ sh+lau ka gnyis kyis bstod/ bdag bskyed kyi lha rnams mdun bskyed la thim par dmigs la/ rang tha mal du gnas pa'i dpung pa g.yas kyi steng du pad zla'i steng du dge slong ma dpal mo rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs can/

phyag gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar nas 'phags pa la ngo chen mdzad par bsams la/ phyag 'tshal zhing / po bstod nyi shu rtsa gcig bya ba ni/ rgya gar skad du/ ar+ya lo ke shwa rā ya bik+ṣu shrī ni ro stot+t+ra nā ma/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug la/ dge slong ma dpal mos bstod pa zhes bya ba/ oṃ bla ma 'jig rten mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten bla ma srid pa gsum gyis bstod pa po/ /lha yi gtso bo bdud dang tshangs pas bstod pa po/ /thub pa'i rgyal mchog bstod pas grub par mdzad pa po/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde gshegs dpag med sku ste sku bzang 'dzin pa po/ /bde gshegs snang mtha' yas kyi dbu rgyan 'dzin pa po/ /phyag g.yas mchog sbyin yi dwags bkres skom sel ba po/ /phyag g.yon gser gyi pad+mas rnam par brgyan pa po/ /dri zhim ral pa'i phreng ba dmar ser 'khyug pa po/ /zhal ras rgyas pa zla ba lta bur mdzes pa po/ /spyan gyi pad+ma mchog tu bzang zhing yangs pa po/ /kha ba dung ltar rnam dkar dri ngad ldan pa po/ /dri med 'od chags mu tig tshom bu 'dzin pa po/ /mdzes pa'i 'od zer skya rengs dmar pos brgyan pa po/ /pad ma'i mtsho ltar phyag ni dngar bar byas pa po/ /ston ka'i sprin gyi mdog dang ldan zhing gzhon pa po/ /rin chen mang pos dpung pa gnyis ni brgyan pa po/ /lo ma'i mchog ltar phyag mthil gzhon zhing 'jam pa po/ /ri dwags pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa po/ /snyan cha gdu bus sgeg cing rgyan rnams 'chang ba po/ /dri ma med pa pad+ma'i mchog la gnas pa po/ /lte ba'i so ni pad+ma'i 'dab ltar 'jam pa po/ /gser gyi ska rags mchog la nor bus spras pa po/ /sta zur dkris pa'i ras bzang sham thabs gsol pa po/ /thub pa'i mkhyen mchog mtsho chen pha rol phyin pa po/ /mchog brnyes bsod nams mang pos nye bar bsags pa po/ /rtag tu bde ba'i 'byung gnas rga nad sel ba po/

/gsum mthar mdzad cing mkha' spyod spyod pa ston pa po/ /lus can mchog ste bdud dpung 'khrug las rgyal ba po/ /gser gyi rkang gdub sgra yis zhabs yid 'ong ba po/ /tshangs pa'i gnas pa bzhi yis spen par mdzad pa po/ /ngang pa'i 'gros 'dra glang chen 'gros ltar gshegs pa po/ /yongs rdzogs nye bar bsags shing bstan pa gnyer ba po/ /'o ma'i mtsho dang chu yi mtsho las sgrol ba po/ /sdug bsngal mtsho dang nyon mongs mtsho las bsgral du gsol/ /gang zhig rtag tu tho rangs langs te gus pa yis/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po yid la sems byed cing / /bstod pa'i mchog 'dis dag cing gsal bar bstod byed na/ /de ni skyes pa'am ni bud med yin kyang rung / /skye ba 'di dang ma 'ongs skye ba thams cad du/ /'jig rten 'jig rten las 'das dgos pa kun 'grub 'gyur/ /ār+ya a wa lo ke shwa ra bik+ṣu shrī ni re li kha ra shing 'phel gyi drung du bstod pa'o/ /'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ 'phags pa spyan gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ khyed la mkhyen brtse'i nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bla ma bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs pa༞ da ltar zhal bzhugs pa'i bla ma rnams sku tshe ring zhing 'gro don 'phel bar༞ dge 'dun pa thams cad chos spyod 'phel bar༞ sems can thams cad la bde skyid 'byung bar༞ sems can thams cad kyi brgyud la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bcos ma ma yin pa brgyud la skye bar༞ zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi ting nge 'dzin skye bar༞ shes bya ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad par can brgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ mdor na mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/

mchod pa a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che las grub pa'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ dpag bsam shing gis kha brgyan pa/ lha'i gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ nang chu dang bcud kyis yongs su gang ba'i pad zla'i steng du dbus su 'od dpag med/ shar du rdo rje sems dpa'/ lhor rin chen 'byung ldan/ nub tu rnam par snang mdzad/ byang du don yod grub pa/ de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin pa āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes pa/ pañtsa ku la sa pā ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ phyogs dus nas khrus bar 'dra/ chu bo gaṅgā'i rgyun bzhin du/ /yon chab rgyun yang mi chad pa/ /bcom ldan 'das bum pa'i lha la 'bul/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pā ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ 'gre'o/ /mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ me tog pad+ma'i tshal bzhin du/ /tsan+dan sdong po'i rgyun bzhin du/ /nyi zla nor bu'i 'od bzhin dang / /ga bur gla rtsi'i rgyun bzhin du/ /so rtsi kha yi ro bzhin du/ /pi waṃ gling bu'i rgyun bzhin du/ /sogs nas rgyas 'debs bar 'dra/ gzungs thag bzung la mdun bskyed kyi lha'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros bum bskyed kyi lha la phog bum bskyed kyi lha'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros bdag gzhan sems can thams cad la phog pas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dag par bsam/

dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'phags pa ye shes rgya mtsho rnam par snang mdzad bkod pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod yon dam pa 'di dag dang / /'jig rten khams kyi mchod yon rnams/ /thams cad blo yis blangs nas ni/ /bcom ldan bum pa'i lha la 'bul/ /oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pā ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ 'gre'o/ /chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang / /zhes pa dang / bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi dmyal ba'i sa bon ngan pa dang bag chags thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig yi dwags kyi༞ dud 'gro'i༞ khams gsum 'khor ba'i༞ mdor na tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa byang nas/ myur du mngon par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas bum nang gi lha rnams bdud rtsir zhu nas bum chu nus ldan du gyur/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan gyi steng du hrī ཿdkar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las thugs rje chen po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa phyag g.yas pas mchog sbyin dang g.yon ut+pa la dkar po snyan gyi thad kar kha phye ba'i yu ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas pa'o/ /de'i spyi bor mar me gcig la gnyis mched kyi tshul du paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po yongs su gyur pa las thugs rje chen po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa bzhengs pa/

phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na shel gyi phreng ba bsnams pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na pad+ma dkar po bsnams pa/ de yi spyi bor mar me gcig la gnyis mched kyi tshul du paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma bcu gnyis lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan gyi steng du hrīḥyongs su gyur pa las bcu gcig zhal rtsa ba'i zhal dbus dkar/ g.yas ljang / g.yon dmar ba de'i steng ma gsum dbus ljang / g.yas dmar/ g.yon dkar/ de'i steng ma gsum dbus dmar/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon ljang ba/ de rnams 'dzum pa'i nyams can/ dbu skra sil ba/ de'i steng du khro zhal nag po mche ba gtsigs pa khro gnyer dang ldan pa spyan gsum pa ral pa dmar po gyen du sgreng ba/ de'i spyi bor 'od dpag med zhi zhal dmar po gtsug gtor dang bcas/ rgyan spangs pa tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/ 'dzum pa'i mgul pa dang bcas pa phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi gnyis pas bgrang phreng / gsum pas mchog sbyin/ bzhi pas 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pas gser gyi pad+ma yu ba dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ gsum pas ril ba spyi blugs/ bzhi pas mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ de'i spyi por paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma bcu drug pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po yongs su gyur pa las 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug phyag stong spyan stong dang ldan pa bzhengs pa rtsa ba'i zhal dbus dkar/ g.yas ljang g.yon dmar ba/ de'i steng ma gsum dbus ljang / g.yas dmar/ g.yon dkar ba de rnams zhi zhal 'dzum pa'i nyams can/ dbu skra sil bu de'i steng du khro zhal dmar po gnyis gshibs pa/ de'i steng du khro zhal nag po mche ba gtsigs shing khro gnyer dang bcas spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ ral pa dmar ser gyen du bsgreng ba/ de'i steng du 'od dpag med zhi zhal dmar po gtsug tor dang bcas/ rgyan spangs pa tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/

'dzum pa'i mgul pa dang bcas pa/ phyag dang po nas mda' gzhu 'dzin pa bar gong bzhin/ phyag lhag ma dgu brgya dang dgu bcu rtsa gnyis pad ma'i 'dab ma ltar 'jam zhing mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ phyag thams cad kyi mthil na spyan re re yod pa/ phyag rnams yar dbu'i gtsug tor dang / mar pus mo'i lha nga las mi 'da' ba bzhi ka'ang / ri dwags kyi pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa/ sku stod la dar dkar po dang / sku smad la ras sna tshogs pas sham thabs rol par 'char ba nor bus spras pa'i gser gyi ske rags bcings pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa'o/ /de'i g.yas kyi pad rtsa la pad zla'i steng du rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa sku mdog dmar po spyi bor rta mgo ljang gu rta skad 'tsher ba phyag g.yas dbyug tho dang / g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ de'i steng du pad zla'i steng du bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sku mdog dmar po phyag g.yas sdigs mdzub/ g.yon zhags pa bsnams pa/ khro bo'i cha lugs can/ g.yon gyi pad rtsa la pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du rnam par rgyal ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar/ g.yas ser/ g.yon sngo ba/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos sna tshogs rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gnyis pa pad+ma'i steng na 'od dpag med bzhugs pa 'dzin pa/ gsum pa na mda'/ bzhi pa mchog sbyin/ phyag g.yon gyi dang po zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub thugs kar mdzad pa/ gnyis pa na gzhu/ gsum pa skyabs sbyin/ bzhi pa mnyam bzhag gi steng na bum pa bsnams pa/ zhabs gnyis bzhengs thabs su bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i spyi bor pad zla'i steng du rje btsun sgrol ma sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon ut+pa la'i rtsa ba thugs kar 'dzin pa zhabs bzhengs pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol du pad zla'i steng du phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhi steng 'og tu phyogs skyong bcu/

phyogs bzhir pad zla'i steng du rgyal po chen po sde bzhi/ de'i phyi rol du pad zla la gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po ji 'jigs la sogs pa gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po bcu gnyis rnams rang rang gi sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs dang ldan pa'o/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng du hrīḥzhal gcig phyag bzhi pa'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng du oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ bcu gcig zhal gyi thugs kar/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ i tre wa tre/ tsa le tsa le/ pra tsa le pra tsa le/ ku su me ku su ma wa re/ i li mi li/ tsi ti dz+wa la/ ma pa na ye swāhā/ phyag stong gi thugs kar pad zla'i steng du/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya sogs gong bzhin/ zhes pa bkod la lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ lte bar hrīḥsna tshogs las 'od zer 'phros pas lho phyogs po tā la la sogs te zhing khams rab 'byams nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad thugs rje chen po bzhi brtsegs kyi rnam par badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥzhes pas ye shes pa spyan drangs la/ lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod bstod bsdus pa gong bzhin/ phyogs dus kun na sogs gong bzhin/ dmigs med mkha' ltar dag cing khyab pa'i sku/ /spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol ba mi dmigs kyang / /thugs rje ngang nyid chos sku dag pa las/ /ye shes sgyu mar rol te gshegs su gsol/ /ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur pa/ /bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /ri bo ta la legs par brgyan pa na/ /drang srong chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang bzhugs/ /'gro ba'i mgon po thugs rje mchog mnga' ba/ /'khor bcas ma lus spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/

/bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru/ /'gro la brtse phyir thugs rje rnam sbyangs shing / /smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na/ /de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas/ /rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing / /mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir/ /yang dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug gtso/ /zla ba nor bu'i mdog 'dra zhing / /nyi ma las lhag gzi brjid che/ /dad pas spyan ni drang bar bgyi/ /zhi zhing thugs rje che ldan pa/ /dul zhing bsam gtan sa la bzhugs/ /chos dang ye shes chags bral ba/ /kun tu mi bzad nus par ldan/ /tshur spyon tshur spyon zhi dag lha/ /thub pa skyes mchog thams cad mkhyen/ /shin tu legs byas gzugs brnyan ni/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang / /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol/ /bcom ldan thugs rjes byon pa la/ /bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ /pad+ma ka ma la ye satwaṃ/ khrus kyi khang pa sogs gong bzhin/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na/ /mchod yon ji snyed yod pa dang / /bdag gi gus pas bshams pa 'di/ /ji snyed rgyal ba sras dang bcas/ /de snyed rnams la bdag 'bul na/ /thugs rje mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes nas kyang / /sems can don kun mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ ār+ya a wa lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ 'gre'o/ /hrīḥlas byung ba'i mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /gangs ri'i mdog can phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dang / /g.yon pa ut+pal dkar po rab 'dzin pa'i/ /rab mdzes sku mnga' khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/

/skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas༞ /thugs rje'i spyan༞ /spyan ras gzigs༞ /dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa sogs/ phyag stong 'khor los bsgyur sogs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par bstim/ slar yang lte ba'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rgyal ba rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ sogs kyis mchod/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang / /zhes sogs kyis bstod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rigs lnga'i thugs ka nas yum sangs rgyas spyan ma/ mā ma kī/ gos dkar mo/ sgrol ma bzhi bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs te/ ji ltar bltams pa nas/ de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro/ /nas rgyas 'debs bar gong bzhin/ mdun bskyed kyi zhabs la spyi bos gtugs par bsam zhing / gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma'i sku ni rdo rje'i sku/ /mdzes shing lta bas chog mi shes/ /bsam gyis mi khyab yon tan ldan/ /bla ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma'i gsung ni tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ /'gag med seng ge'i sgra dang ldan/ /mu stegs log lta 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /bla ma'i gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma'i thugs ni nam mkha' 'dra/ /bde gsal mi rtogs ngang tshul can/ /rnam thar gsum la legs gnas pa'i/ bla ma'i thugs༞ /sku 'gyur ba med pa bla ma'i sku/ /gsung 'gag pa med pa bla ma'i gsung / /thugs 'khrul pa med pa bla ma'i thugs/ /bla ma'i sku gsung thugs la༞ /bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos/ /de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te/ /kun gyi mdzad po bla ma yin/

/bla ma rnams la༞ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rab tu bsngags/ /yon tan dam pa kun nas gsal/ /spyan ras gzigs su mtshan gsol ba'i/ /rtag par brtse la༞ /spyan ras gzigs bsnyung gnas brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal ba ni/ grub pa mchog brnyes dge slong dpal mo dang / /rang lus lhar gzigs ye shes bzang po dang / /nyon mongs gdung sel zla 'od gzhon nu ste/ /yi dam zhal gzigs gsum la༞ /lnga brgya'i thams cad mkhyen pa a ti sha /lha rigs yon tan mkhyen pa'i byang chub 'od/ /'gro ba'i skyabs gnas chen po pe nya ba/ /skyes mchog dam pa gsum la༞ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug zla ba rgyal mtshan dpal/ /'phags pa'i lung bstan thob pa'i nyi phug pa/ /dka' spyad mthar phyin bshes gnyen grags lung pa/ /spyan ras gzigs sprul gsum la༞ /rgyal ba'i byin rlabs zhugs pa'i dkon mchog grags/ /sgo gsum gzhan don mdzad pa'i lha sdings pa/ /gdul bya'i re skong rin chen rgyal mtshan ste/ /gzhan don mthar phyin gsum la༞ /spangs rtogs mthar phyin mkhan chen 'dzin pa dang / /bslab gsum brgyad ldan mnga' ris rgyal mtshan dang / /mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan ma ti paṇa chen ste/ /snyigs ma'i 'dren pa gsum la༞ /sbas pa'i rnal 'byor byang sems nyi ma dang / /grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal po'i zhabs/ /chos dang rigs kyi sras gyur nyi ma bzang / /thugs rje bzang po'i zhabs la༞ /dam chos phyag chen don rtogs dpal mtsho dang / /skad gnyis smra ba 'gyur med bde ba che/ /bde ba'i 'byung gnas skal bzang dbang po dang / /grub pa'i dbon po gsum la༞ /grub pa'i dpa' bo bkra shis rnam rgyal dang / /rgyal sras rnam sprul bstan 'dzin nor bu dang / /rig 'dzin chen po stobs ldan dpal 'byor te/ /snyigs dus grub dbang gsum la༞ /sbas pa'i brtul zhugs ngag dbang yongs grags zhabs/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang gnas gsar legs pa'i mtshan/ /srid gsum 'gro la gzigs pa'i thugs rje can/

/rnam gsum 'dren pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la gsol btab mthus/ /tha mal tshe 'di'i snang ba 'gag pa'i tshe/ /bar do'i 'khrul snang sna tshogs rab 'gag nas/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang myur thob shog /chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang / /gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal/ /thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la༞ /mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ston pa po/ /bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhing / /de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dag pa 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu/ /dge bas ngan song las grol zhing / /gcig pur don dam mchog gyur pa'i/ /zhi gyur chos la༞ /grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston/ /bslab pa dag la rab tu gus/ /zhing gi dam pa yon tan zhing / /dge 'dun la yang༞ /sangs rgyas rnam gzigs gtsug tor thams cad skyobs/ /'khor ba 'jig dang gser thub 'od srungs dang / /shākya thub pa gau tam lha yi lha/ /sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun la༞ /mthun pa'i smon lam dge tshogs rmad byung zhing / /spyad pa spyod tshe nam yang mched gyur la/ /bskal bzang gcig la mdzad pa mthar phyin pa'i/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtshan legs rin chen dpal dang gser bzang dang / /mya ngan med dang chos grags mngon mkhyen dang / /sman gyi bla dang shākya'i rgyal po sogs/ /bde bar gshegs pa brgyad la༞ /pad+ma kha 'bus ji 'dra ba/ /lag gnyis spyi bor thal sbyar te/ /lus dpag med pa'i sprin tshogs kyis/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal/ /mar me mdzad sogs 'das pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /thub pa chen po da lta bzhugs pa dang / /byams pa la sogs slad nas 'byon pa yi/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams la༞ /mtshan mchog ldan pa dri med zla ba'i zhal/ /gser mdog 'dra ba khyod la༞ /rdul bral khyod 'dra srid pa gsum ma mchis/

/mnyam med mkhyen can khyod la༞ /'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med/ /dus min 'chi ba ma lus 'joms pa'i dpal/ /mgon med sdug bsngal gyur pa rnams kyi skyabs/ /sangs rgyas tshe dpag med la phyag༞ /hrīḥlas byung ba'i mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /gangs ri'i mdog can phyag g.yas mchod sbyin mdzad/ /g.yon pa ut+pal dkar po rab 'dzin pa'i/ /rab mdzes zhi ba'i sku la༞ /skyon kyis ma gos sku mdog dkar/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis dbu la brgyan/ /thugs rje'i spyan gyis 'gro la gzigs/ /spyan ras gzigs la༞ /dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi sku/ /'gro drug sems can rnams la spyan ras gzigs/ /nam mkha' lta bur khyab pa'i bcu gcig zhal/ /gzi brjid 'od dpag med la༞ /phyag stong 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po stong / /spyan stong bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong / /gang la gang 'dul de la der ston pa'i/ /btsun pa spyan ras gzigs la༞ /sangs rgyas bye phrag bcu gcig zhal/ /rtsa ba'i zhal ni dkar la mdzes/ /ljang dang dmar po g.yas dang g.yon/ /zhi ba'i zhal la༞ /de steng dbus zhal ljang la mdzes/ /g.yas dmar g.yon pa dkar la 'tsher/ /spyan ni dkyus ring zhal 'dra ba'i/ /'dzum bcas bzhugs la༞ /de steng khro zhal gnyis gshibs dmar/ /nag po gnyis gshibs mche ba gtsigs/ /steng zhal dmar po gtsug tor can/ /bcu gcig zhal༞ /chos nyid thugs chud thugs kar thal mo sbyar/ /thugs rje rgyun mi chad pa'i phreng ba 'dzin/ /yi dwags bkres skom sel ba'i mchog sbyin mdzad/ /phyag g.yas 'khor lo bsnams༞ /'khor ba'i 'dam gyis ma gos pad+ma bsnams/ /ril ba spyi blugs nyon mongs dri ma khrus/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med mda' gzhu 'dzin/ /rnam thar brgyad ldan khyed la༞ /rgyan lnga kun nas rab tu mun sel ba/ /sku mdog dkar gsal ri dwags pags pa 'dzin/ /gzhon nu lang tsho ldan pa'i 'dzum bag can/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel la༞

/yang gsang khros dang bdud rtsi 'khyil/ /me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na/ /h+ya ghṛ wa rta mchog dpal/ /rta mgo ljang gu 'tsher la༞ /lha dang lha min cod pan gyis/ /zhabs kyi pad+mo la btud de/ /phongs pa kun las sgrol mdzad ma/ /sgrol ma yum la༞ /dpal ldan lha mo ston ka'i zla ba'i mdog /zhal gsum phyag brgyad rab mdzes zhi ba'i sku/ /ye shes dpag yas tshe yi mchog stsol ma/ /rnam par rgyal ma'i zhabs la༞ /'jam dbyangs phyag na rdo rje spyan ras gzigs/ /sa yi snying po sgrib pa rnam par sel/ /nam mkha'i snying po byams pa kun tu bzang / /nye ba'i sras chen brgyad la༞ /ye shes bla ma 'od kyi tog /de bzhin smon lam blo gros dang / /dbang po zhi dang 'jam dbyangs la/ /bdag ni gus pas༞ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rdzogs mdzad cing / /sa bcu'i yon tan ma lus mngon gyur nas/ /rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /byang sems 'phags pa'i tshogs la༞ /yul 'khor srung dang 'phags skyes po/ /spyan mi bzang dang rnam thos sras/ /mgon po lcam dral la sogs pa'i/ /chos skyong rnams la༞ /sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i dge bsnyen mchog /'jigs pa'i gzugs can rngams pa'i cha lugs can/ /bdun 'bum 'khor gyis bskor ba'i bcu gnyis po/ /gnod sbyin sde dpon rnams la༞ /mkha' ltar khyab pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas la/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pas/ /lus 'di zhing rdul mnyam par rab sprul nas/ /rtag tu gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed su dag sogs bzang spyod yan lag bdun pa bdag gis bstod bar/ rat+na maṇ+ḍa la puṣ+pe pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ 'gre'o/ /me tog dam pa phreng ba dam pa dang sogs nas/ mchod par bgyi bar rol mo/ 'dod chags sogs tsog pu/ thal sbyar gyis bshags pa bsngo ba'i mthar phyag gcig stan la 'khod/ dkyil 'khor kun tu rgyal ba mnyes mdzad pa'i/

/rin chen me tog la sogs mchod pa'i rdzas/ /nam mkha' lta bur sems kyis mngon sprul te/ /gzhal yas khang du rim gyis bstim gyur cig /oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi yongs su dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badz+ra re ṣe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri khor yug gis bskor ba'i dbus su/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling / nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ lus dang lus 'phags/ rnga yab dang rnga yab gzhan/ g.yo ldan dang lam mchog 'gro/ sgra mi snyan dang sgra mi snyan gyi zla/ rin po che'i ri bo/ dpag bsam gyi shing / 'dod 'jo'i ba/ ma rmos pa'i lo tog 'khor lo rin po che/ nor bu rin po che/ btsun mo rin po che/ blon po rin po che/ glang po rin po che/ rta mchog rin po che/ dmag dpon rin po che/ gter chen po'i bum pa/ sgeg mo ma/ phreng ba ma/ glu ma/ gar ma/ me tog ma/ bdug spos ma/ mar me ma/ dri chab ma/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ rin po che'i gdugs/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan/ dbus su lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa gang yang ma tshang ba med pa gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba 'di nyid/ drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / yi dam thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas bdag sogs la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing me tog bkram/ /ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis/ /'gro kun rnam dag zhing du spyod par shog /mnyes phyir maṇ+ḍal bzang po 'di phul bas/ /byang chub lam la bar chad mi 'byung zhing / /dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa rtogs pa dang / /srid par mi 'khrul zhi bar mi gnas par/ /mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro rnams sgrol bar shog

/sku gsum yongs rdzogs bla ma'i tshogs rnams la/ /phyi nang gsang gsum de bzhin nyid kyis mchod/ /bdag lus longs spyod snang srid yongs bzhes nas/ /bla med mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la sogs pa phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas tha ma da lta'i bar du bsags pa nyon mongs pa 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug gi dbang gis sbyor ba lus dang ngag dang yid kyi sgo nas sdig pa mi dge ba bcu bgyis pa dang / mtshams med pa lnga bgyis pa dang / de dang nye ba lnga bgyis pa dang / so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang 'gal ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya dang 'gal ba dang / gsang sngags kyi dam tshig dang 'gal ba dang / dkon mchog gsum la ma gus pa dang / pha dang ma la ma gus pa dang / mkhan po dang slob dpon la ma gus pa dang / grogs tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams la ma gus pa dang / dam pa'i chos spangs pa dang / gsung rab kyi bslus zos pa dang / 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la skur ba btab pa la sogs pa mdor na mtho ris dang thar pa'i gegs su gyur cing / 'khor ba dang ngan song gi rgyur gyur pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung gi tshogs ci bgyis pa dang / bgyid du stsal ba dang / bgyis pa la rjes su yi rang ba de dag thams cad bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la sogs pa/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la mthol lo bshags so/ /mi 'chab bo/ /mi sbed do/ /slan chad kyang bsdam par bgyid lags so/ /zhes lan gsum/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gis ni/ /lus dang ngag dang༞ /sdig pa bdag gis༞ /de dag thams cad bdag gis so sor bshags/ /zhes sogs brjod cing / nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa ji tsam pa/ /sems can ma lus mtha' yang de bzhin te/

/ji tsam las dang nyon mongs mthar gyur pa/ /bdag gi sdig bshags mtha' yang de tsam mo/ /zhes dang / bdag gi phyag mchod mtha' yang de tsam mo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rta cang shes lta bu/ glang po chen po/ bya ba byas shing byed pa byas pa khur bor ba/ rang gi don rjes su thob pa/ srid pa kun tu sbyor ba/ yongs su zad pa/ yang dag pa'i bka'/ legs par rnam par grol ba'i thugs/ legs par rnam par grol ba'i shes rab can de dag gis sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir dang / phan par bya ba'i phyir dang / grol bar bya ba'i phyir dang / nad med par bya ba'i phyir dang / mu ge med par bya ba'i phyir dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rtogs par bya ba'i phyir dang / gso sbyong nges par mdzad pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang / sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir dang / phan par bya ba'i phyir dang / grol bar bya ba'i phyir dang / nad med par bya ba'i phyir dang / mu ge med par bya ba'i phyir dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar gso sbyong gi sdom pa nges par yang dag par blang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gsum dang / deng nas srog gcod mi bya zhing / /gzhan gyi nor yang blang mi bya/ /'khrig pa'i chos kyang mi spyad cing / /rdzun gyi tshig kyang mi smra'o/ /skyon ni mang po nyer brten pa'i/ /chang ni yongs su spang bar bya/ /khri stan mthon po mi bya zhing /

/de bzhin dus ma yin pa'i zas/ /dri dang phreng ba rgyan dang ni/ /gar dang glu sogs spang bar bya/ /ji ltar dgra bcom rtag tu ni/ /srog gcod la sogs mi byed ltar/ /de bzhin srog gcod la sogs spangs/ /bla med byang chub myur thob shog /sdug bsngal mang 'khrugs 'jig rten 'di/ /srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog /ces lan gsum brjod/ oṃ badz+ra dzi hoḥ lce rdo rje dang pad+ma'i rang bzhin can du gyur cig oṃ ru tsi ra ma ṇi pra warta ya hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ tshar gsum/ oṃ a mo ghā shī la saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra/ bha ra bha ra/ ma hā shud+dha satwa pad+ma bi bhu ṣi ta/ bhu dza/ dha ra dha ra/ sa man+ta a wa lo ke te hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes brgya rtsa gcig bzlas nas/ sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la tshul khrims kyi phung po yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig ting nge 'dzin gyi༞ shes rab kyi༞ rnam par grol ba'i ye shes gzigs pa'i phung po yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig khrims kyi tshul khrims skyon med cing / /tshul khrims rnam par dag dang ldan/ /rlom sems med pa'i tshul khrims kyis/ /tshul khrims pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /ji ltar 'dod pa'i bslab pa phra mo yang / /nges 'byung bsam pa byang chub thob byed cing / /srog gi phyir yang btang bar mi nus pa'i/ /thar pa'i rgyal mtshan rtag tu 'dzin par shog /rang gzhan 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i dge ba la dga' ba bsgom zhing / sems can kun gyi ngan song gi /sdug bsngal ngal gso'i dge ba dang / /sdug bsngal can rnams bde gnas pa/ /dga' bas rjes su yi rang ngo / /zhes dang / phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun dang sangs rgyas sras/ /rang rgyal rnams dang༞ /'gro ba kun gyis༞ /de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag yi rang / /gang rnams phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sgron ma rnams/ /byang chub rim par༞ /mgon po de dag༞ /chos 'khor bla na med pa bskor bar bskul/ /rgyal ba mya ngan 'da' bzhed la/

/thal mo sbyar te gsol ba ni/ /'gro 'di nongs par mi 'god cing / /bskal pa grangs med bzhugs par gsol/ /mya ngan 'das ston gang bzhed de dag la/ /'gro ba kun la༞ /bskal pa zhing gi༞ /bdag gis thal mo rab sbyar gsol bar bgyi/ /mdun bskyed kyi lha bzhi'i thugs ka'i yig 'bru la rim gyis sems gtad nas klog pa'i tshul du bzlas pas yig 'bru rnams las 'od zer byung nas rang la phog pas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig pa sangs kyis dag par gyur/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i thugs ka'i pad zla'i steng du hrīḥyid kyis bzlas/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa'i thugs ka'i pad zla'i steng du/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ brgya rtsa gcig bcu gcig zhal gyi thugs ka'i pad zla'i steng du/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ dha ra nas/ ma pa na ye swa hā/ bar tshar gcig dang / ma ṇi nyer gcig phyag stong spyan stong gi thugs ka'i pad zla'i steng du/ na mo rat+na tra yā nas/ ma pa na ye swāhā bar nyer gcig 'jig rten khams 'di dpag med na/ /mchod yon ji snyed yod pa kun/ /sangs rgyas sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ ār+ya a wa lo ki te shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ zhes pa 'gre/ dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi sku zhes sh+lau ka gcig gis bstod/ sems can thams cad kyi dmyal ba'i sa bon ngan pa dang bag chags thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig yi dwags kyi sa bon ngan pa dang bag chags༞ dud 'gro'i༞ khams gsum 'khor ba'i༞ mdor na tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa byang nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par gyur cig gtor ma rnams a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ aḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir gyur par bsam la/ na mo rat+na nas ma pa na ye swāhā/ bar lnga'am bdun gyis phul/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/

puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+ta aḥhūm̐ gis mchod/ skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar/ /zhes pas bstod/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bla ma dang thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la 'bul lo/ /sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod do/ /gnyis pa oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇaṃ a d+yā nut+pan+na twat+ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis dbul/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ sogs gong bzhin/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di dpal mgon lcam dral/ tshangs pa brgya byin la sogs pa phyogs skyong ba bcu/ rgyal po chen po sde bzhi/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po bcu gnyis la sogs te/ chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams la 'bul lo/ /dam pa'i chos bsgrub pa rnams kyi 'gal rkyen thams cad zhi zhing / mthun rkyen thams cad chos ldan yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod do/ /gsum pa yang a kā ro gsum dang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyal ba rin chen mang la༞ gzugs mdzes dam pa la༞ sku 'byams klas la༞ 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtor ma 'di gnas bdag gzhi bdag rnams la 'bul lo/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas 'gro ba la ru nga ba dang / sdod pa la phrag dog ma mdzad/ gzhi chos ldan du skyong ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ me long la lha'i gzugs brnyan shar ba la/ bum chu blug cing / khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa/ /ces sh+lau ka gcig dang / oṃ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka sogs/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /sh+lau ka gcig dang / oṃ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka sogs/ de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la/ /sh+lau ka gcig 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan/

/thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med/ /byin rlabs ye shes chu yin te/ /ci 'dod dngos grub stsol bar mdzod/ /oṃ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i sku la 'gyur ba mi mnga' yang / /sems can lus kyi sgrib pa sbyang slad du/ /rgyal ba'i sku la khrus chab 'di gsol bas/ /sems can lus kyi sgrib pa dag gyur cig /oṃ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta༞ rgyal ba'i gsung la 'gag pa mi mnga' yang / /sems can ngag gi sgrib pa sbyang slad du/ /rgyal ba'i gsung la khrus chab 'di gsol bas/ /sems can ngag gi sgrib pa dag gyur cig /oṃ gu ru sarba ta༞ rgyal ba'i thugs la 'khrul pa mi mnga' yang / /sems can yid kyi sgrib pa sbyang slad du/ /rgyal ba'i thugs la khrus chab༞ /sems can yid kyi sgrib pa༞ /oṃ gu ru sarba༞ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang / /sems can lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa sbyang slad du/ /rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la khrus༞ /sems can lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa༞ /oṃ gu ru sarba༞ 'di ni khrus mchog zhes sh+lau ka gciga.oṃ gu ru༞ 'gro ba'i sgron me spyan ras gzigs dbang la/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyi khrus chab 'di gsol bas/ /dri chab sku gsum brnyes pa'i bkra shis shog /oṃ gu ru༞ 'gro ba'i sgron me rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyi khrus chab 'di gsol bas/ /dri chab sku gsum brnyes pa'i bkra shis shog /oṃ gu ru༞ 'gro ba'i sgron me dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyi khrus chab༞ /khams gsum sems can sgrib pa kun byang nas/ /dri chab sku gsum brnyes pa'i bkra shis shog /oṃ gu ru༞ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/ /gtsang la dri rab bsgos pas sku phyi'o/ /oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥka ya bi shwa dha na ye swāhā/ de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i/ /na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa 'bul/

/gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs dang / /rgyan mchog brgya phrag de dang de dag gis/ /'phags pa kun tu bzang dang 'jam dbyangs dang / /'jig rten dbang phyug sogs la brgyan par bgyi/ /oṃ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra wasatra āḥhūm̐/ srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku la 'bul/ /mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra wasatra āḥhūm̐/ na bza' pañtsha na bza' bla bre dang / /na bza' bkod pa'i 'od zer rab rgyas shing / /na bza' sna tshogs kun tu bkram byas nas/ /bdag nyid chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang mchod/ /oṃ ār+ya a wa lo ke te shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra wasatrā swāhā/ sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra zhing / /gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur gyur pa/ /gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyang phyir 'bul/ /bzod pa dam pa'i gos gyis brgyan par gyis/ /oṃ ār+ya a wa lo ke te shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra/ 'khor lo nor bu btsun mo blon po dang / /glang po rta mchog dmag dpon rin chen rnams/ /dkyil 'khor lha la phul bas 'gro ba yis/ /'phags pa'i nor bdun dag la spyod par shog /oṃ ār+ya a wa lo ke te sap+ta rat+na pū dzi te hūm̐/ phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang / /zhes sh+lau ka gcig skye zhing skye ba dag ni thams cad du/ /rigs bzang blo gsal nga rgyal med pa dang / /snying rje che zhing bla ma la gus pa'i/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi dam tshig ldan par shog /ces dang / khyed la mchod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /sogs/ de nas lhag chad kha bskang zhing yi ge brgya pa bya/ bzod gsol bya ba ni/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa khyed rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag las dang por gyur pas/ sems bying ba dang rgod pa'i dbang gis/ ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang / sngags ma dag pa dang / cho ga lhag chad du gyur pa dang /

gtsang sbra chung ba la sogs pa thams cad 'phags pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa khyed rnams la bzod par gsol zhing / bdag la sgrib par mi 'gyur bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ dus ngan sems can spyod pa dman/ /ma rig nyon mongs dang 'dres pa/ /'phags pa'i thugs dgongs ma rdzogs par/ /de yang bzod par mdzad du gsol/ /ser sna'i dbang gyur mi mkhas pa/ /mchod pa ngan zhing bshams nyes pa/ /sbyor ba gtsang sbra ma thon pa/ /de yang bzod par༞ gtso bor nus pa ma mchis shing / /ma tshang ba dang 'gal ba sogs/ /gang yang bgyi 'os ma bgyis pas/ /de yang༞ /bag med spyod pa ma dag pa/ /rgyud las gsungs pa'i cho ga bzhin/ /ma lcogs 'khrul pa ci mchis pa/ /de yang༞ /gang yang bdag rmongs gti mug pas/ /legs byas 'di la nyes pa gang / /gang phyir lus can skyabs gyur pa/ /de yang༞ /ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de yang bzod par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes brjod do/ /de nas ras bris la sogs pa'i/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya ste/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten 'di rnams la 'byung ba chen po bzhi'i gnod pa ma byung gi bar du/ ye shes pa rnams brtan par bzhugs nas bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen dam pa mdzad du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ oṃ lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod/ rten mi bzhugs na/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes brjod do/ /mdun bskyed kyi ye shes pa gshegs/

dam tshig pa rang la thim/ spyod lam thams cad du zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa'i nga rgyal dang ma bral bar bya'o/ /de nas shis pa brjod pa ni/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo dbang gi rgyal po ltar/ /sh+lau ka gcig ston mchog dam pa lha mi'i mchod 'os pa/ /sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ /de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /zhi ba chags bral༞ /chos la༞ /sems can gang dag༞ /de dag thams cad༞ /tshogs kyi dam pa༞ /dge 'dun phyag 'tshal༞ /sems can gang dag༞ /de dag thams cad༞ /yang dag don gyi 'og min na/ /bzhugs pa'i rdo rje 'chang chen 'di/ /sprul pa'i sangs rgyas mi'i gzugs can/ /thang stong rgyal po'i bkra shis shog /me tog gang la phog pa de/ /las dang skal bar ldan pa yin/ /bskal pa du ma rab bsgrubs pa'i/ /yi dam lha yi༞ /bla ma'i bka' lung dbang bzhi'i don/ /yengs med nyams len dam tshig srung / /rang la bla ma mched lcam gces/ /rdo rje spun grogs༞ /mthu stobs nus pa phrin las phun tshogs shing / /skad cig dran pas bar chad thams cad sel/ /'du 'bral med par dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i/ /phyag drug ye shes༞ /sngon tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga ru/ /chos bzhin༞ /ma yis bu༞ /chos skyong srung ma༞ /bka' brgyud thang stong rgyal po 'di'i/ /snyan brgyud gdams pa'i bkra shis shog /bshad brgyud mu tig bkra shis shog /sgrub brgyud dar ba'i bkra shis shog /'jig rten 'dren pa'i༞ /dus min༞ /mgon med༞ /sangs rgyas tshe༞ /lo brgya 'tsho zhing ston brgya mthong ba dang / /longs spyod rgyas shing bsam don 'grub pa dang / /chos la bar chad med cing sgrub mthar phyin/ /brgyud 'dzin byin gyis brlabs pa'i༞ /yin lugs don la skye ba med gyur kyang / /rigs drug ngan 'gro'i skye sgo bsam mi khyab/ /deng nas 'gro kun skye ba thams cad du/ /yin lugs skye med rtogs pa'i bkra shis shog

/yin lugs don la rgas༞ /na tshod 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal༞ /deng nas 'gro༞ /yin lugs rgas med༞ /yin lugs don la na med༞ /'byung bzhi 'khrul ba'i sdug bsngal༞ /deng nas 'gro༞ /yin lugs na med༞ /yin lugs don la 'chi ba༞ /sa steng 'di na rtag par sdod dbang med/ /yin lugs 'chi med rtogs pa'i༞ /cir snang bla mar bsgom pa'i༞ /nang don bla ma mjal ba'i༞ /cir snang yi dam du bsgom pa'i༞ /mchog thun mong gi dngos grub mjal ba'i༞ /cir snang pha mar bsgom pa'i༞ /thabs shes pha ma mjal ba'i༞ /rang la rang phan byed pa'i༞ /gzhan phan lhun gyis grub pa'i༞ /nyams dang 'od gsal 'dres pa'i༞ 'od gsal ma bu 'dres pa'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shing / /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa'i/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis shog /de nas oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas mdun gyi nam mkhar/ yi ge drug pa byon nas phyag nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun rang la blugs par bsam zhing / rang gzhan bkrus pas dang pos nyon sgrib dag gnyis pas shes bya'i sgrib pa dag gsum pas skye med chos sku mngon du gyur par bsam mo/ /mthar 'phags pa yi ge drug pa rang la bsdu'o/ /de ltar sa ga zla ba'i tshes bcu la sbyor ba/ bco lnga la dngos gzhi/ bcu drug la rjes chog zhes sbyor dngos rjes gsum la cho ga shin tu dag pa tshar re bya/ sbyor ba'i nyin par dkar gsum la brten pa'i gdan cig bya/ sha chang sgog btsong la sogs pa'i zas ngan pa rnams mi za/ /dngos gzhi'i nyin tho rangs gnyid sad nas smra bcad bya/ 'bru nyag gcig gam/ chu thigs pa gcig gi yang bza' btung mi bya/ cho ga yid kyis bya/ nyal ba'i tshe snod bcud lha la bsdu/ lha rnams zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa la bsdu/ de yang thugs ka'i hrīḥl bsdu/ ra ta ha la bsdu/ ha gi gu la༞ de dag rim gyis yal nas stong pa nyid kyi ngang la seng ge'i nyal thabs su nyol/

tho rangs skya rengs shar nas thor 'thung ba phyag len na yod/ rjes kyi nyin gso sbyong ma gtogs pa'i cho ga tshar bar bya/ bsnyen pa'i skabs su sa ga nas 'go btsugs la snron gyi bar brgya yan ci 'grub la 'bad do/ /de'i phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab ste 'phags pa'i zhal nas/ btsun pa bdag gis snying po 'di ni de ltar rdzu 'phrul che ba lags so/ /lan gcig brjod pas rtsa ba'i ltung ba bzhi po dag kyang byang bar 'gyur ro/ /mtshams ma mchis pa lnga po dag kyang byang bar 'gyur na/ ji skad bshad pa bzhin nan tan tu bgyis pas lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ de dag ni sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed par 'gyur ba lags na bzlas brjod bgyis pa dang / bsgrubs pas lta smos kyang ci 'tshal te/ bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du rdzogs par bgyi'o/ /zhes thang stong rgyal po lugs kyi spyan ras gzigs bzhi brtsegs kyi ma ṇi bum sgrub byed tshul lcags zam pa'i mthong brgyud thos brgyud bkod pa'i yi ge zhig gtsang stod dpal gyi ri bo che nas zhabs drung rgya mtsho rnam rgyal nas gnang byung ba bzhin/ a li chos rje'i ngo ma bzlog par rnam rab dwags po grwa tshang slob dpon dang / a mgon pad+ma mgon nas kyang / rtsom dgos zhes pa sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang por bskul ba las gong gi 'ol bzo bcos cung zad byas nas dpal sa skya'i bla chen 'phags pa rin po che'i tshoms dmar phu gdan sa pa rim can gyi gzim sbug mkha' spyod du legs par sbyar ba'i dge bas bskul ba pos thog drang sems can sdug bsngal las thar nas spyan ras gzigs grub dbang thang stong rgyal po'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig tshul de lta bus bsgrubs pa'i bum chus de la byin rlabs khung btsun du ma bsres pa'i zan ril gtsang ma grib skam can pad kha las mi che ba'i ril bu mtshal gyi na bza' 'od can gsol ba ras skye gangs sogs du ma bcos nas lhung bzed lta bur blugs la dar dri med kyis zhal bkab stegs kyi khar mañdzi lta bur bzhugs gsol mdun mchod pa ci 'byor bshams/

pad+ma'i dbyibs can gyi 'bur zhig la gzungs thag ring mo btags nas dge 'dun zhal grangs ji tsam yod pas bzung rgyu ni sbyor ba'o/ /dngos gzhi bdag bskyed gong bzhin grub 'phral gzungs thag nas dge 'dun thams cad kyis bzung / rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la 'khril nas song bas de'i 'od zer gyis rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems nyan thos rang rgyal chos skyong nor lha sogs skyabs gnas thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse nus mthu'i byin rlabs thams cad dang 'jig rten snod bcud kyi ro bcud ji snyed mchis pa thams cad 'od zer dkar po'i rnam pas ril bu la thim pas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi ngo bor gyur te 'gro ba gang gis zos pa tsam gyis sdig sgrib dag tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i dngos grub stsol ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ zhes dang / oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes dge 'dun zhal grangs kyis nyin gsum tsam bsags pas dung phyur 'gro ba la tshegs med/ de nas mchod bstod gang rung zhig byas/ gzungs thag bsdu'o/ /rjes ni mjug chog gong bzhin dang / de lta bu'i dril bu de snod gtsang mar bzhugs pa gtsug lag khang lta bur gces spras byas nas/ 'gro ba thams cad la byin pas spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro// //zhes pa'ang sa skya pa kun blos so// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ spyan ras gzigs grub dbang thang stong rgyal po'i lugs kyi ma ṇi bum sgrub/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
